name: Miyama Kayabuki no Sato
description: A preserved Miyama mountain village of traditional thatched houses, small cultural facilities, and rural scenery. The village itself is the experience; its houses, museum context, shrine, and seasonal events are not split into synthetic destination cards.

en.name: Miyama Kayabuki no Sato
en.description: A preserved Miyama mountain village of traditional thatched houses, small cultural facilities, and rural scenery. The village itself is the experience; its houses, museum context, shrine, and seasonal events are not split into synthetic destination cards.
en.notes: The village is a living community. Respect private homes and use the designated parking area; vehicles are not allowed inside the village except for residents and related parties.
en.reservation: Ordinary village walking does not use a timed admission ticket; large-bus and group parking reservations may be required. Check the official visitor guidance for current event/facility rules.
en.parking: Use the designated parking lot in front of the village. The official site publishes seasonal opening hours and cooperation fees; do not park in the village or neighborhood without permission.
en.openingHours: Hours and closures vary by date; check the official visitor guidance before visiting.

ja.name: 美山かやぶきの里
ja.description: 伝統的なかやぶき民家が残る美山の山間集落で、民家の町並みや小さな文化施設、農村景観を歩いて楽しめます。民家・資料館・社寺・季節行事は一つの集落体験として扱います。
highlights: 保存されたかやぶき民家の町並み
かやぶきの里資料館周辺
山里の景観と地域の食
ja.notes: 住民が暮らす集落のため、私有地への立ち入りを避け、指定駐車場を利用してください。住民・関係者以外の車両は集落内に入れません。
ja.reservation: 予約・入場条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.parking: 駐車場・アクセス条件は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
ja.openingHours: 開館時間・休館日は変更される場合があるため、訪問前に公式案内をご確認ください。
